limitations: Snapshot only; concurrent additions or content changes require readback. SHA256 seals each recommended file.
tmp subtree is not enumerated; manifest excludes itself from counts. Foreign adjudication-zcode-main.md is excluded.

Probe sources/backend wrapper and command records contain historical absolute paths and build-specific library names; adjust paths and rebuild matching binaries for replay. This is portable evidence, not a hermetic runnable environment.
Generated databases, SCIP indexes, fixture source copies, executable stubs, PID/lock markers and compiled probes remain on disk but are not recommended for staging.
All attempt-root command/result JSON and failed-attempt logs are preserved for traceability; earlier failures are not promoted to accepted evidence.
Historical receipt/command text may mention excluded fixture paths. Direct markdown references are inventoried; free-text references are not an exhaustive machine-validated closure.
No secret-redaction audit or runtime revalidation performed. No source/card/git mutation, deletion, commit or deployment performed.
